::: {.callout-note}
## Still attested only by early project notes
The full title, corporate author, and approximate date on this page were first named in [jordanforge-infrastructure issue 10](https://github.com/jordanforge-ca/jordanforge-infrastructure/issues/10). A second public-source pass on 20 September 2026, including targeted CMHC / publications.gc.ca and bibliographic searches, did **not** recover a catalogue record, digitized copy, or independent secondary citation that repeats that title. The verification label is therefore `open-question` for the bibliographic details themselves: we have a named wanted item, not independent confirmation.
:::

## Identification

| Element | As first named for this archive | Independent public evidence seen in this pass |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Title | Keys on Freedom: Resource manual for the development of self-managed community living alternatives for quadriplegic persons | Not found |
| Creator | BC Rehabilitation Society | BC Rehab is independently attested as a 1990 ECPM manual issuer ([Roeher bibliography](1990s-roeher-if-bibliography.qmd)); that bibliography does **not** list *Keys on Freedom* |
| Date | c. 1990 | Not independently confirmed |

Early project notes asked specifically for 1990s CMHC material citing both the Creekview 202 evaluation **and** *Keys on Freedom*. No such CMHC report was located.

## Search leads documented (20 September 2026)

None of the following returned this title.

- Quoted-title and “self-managed community living” / “resource manual” web searches with BC Rehab or quadriplegic.
- Internet Archive advanced search for `"Keys on Freedom"` with `quadriplegic` (zero items).
- Web searches phrased as WorldCat / CMHC / “Canada Mortgage” queries.
- publications.gc.ca-style CMHC collection browsing for Creekview 202 / Keys on Freedom (no matching hit retrieved).
- The Roeher Institute / Brian Salisbury annotated bibliography (inspected PDF). It cites the 1990 ECPM skill-development manual and does not list *Keys on Freedom*.

UBC, SFU, CMHC Housing Knowledge Centre, and Legislative Library catalogue interfaces were not successfully queried as native catalogues. They remain the highest-value next checks.

## Annotation

This remains a catalogue placeholder for a named resource manual. Absence from the Roeher bibliography and from retrieved CMHC lists is **not** proof the manual never existed. It is a negative finding from the public sources actually seen.

Do not upgrade `verification_status` to `bibliographically-confirmed` until an independent catalogue record, citation, or copy is inspected.

## Open questions

- Location of a copy.
- Exact publication date, edition, pagination, and title-page wording.
- Whether the work is distinct from the 1990 ECPM *Skill Development Manual*.
- Whether a CMHC 1990s housing bibliography cites it (still unfound).
